notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter, Zaiqa Kitchen and Zaiqa Stock apps, version 2.30.0.

New: Zaiqa Stock is now exactly like your paper register
• One page on the phone: Usage | Opening | Closing | Item, in your register's order (Urdu names supported). Opening is filled from last night's closing, staff only fix what is different
• Submit once: after the stock keeper submits Opening or Closing it is locked - he cannot change it. Only the admin can correct a number
• Stock In and Waste buttons keep the "1.5 + 4" style entries; Usage is worked out automatically (Opening + Added - Closing)
• New POS screen "Stock Register": every date in one list, tap a date to see that day's page, print/PDF or send to Telegram, tap an item for its history
• Admin corrections (admin PIN + reason) are saved with old and new value, who and when, and shown as a change history; Telegram is told if it is on
• Still works only on the shop Wi-Fi and only while a POS shift is open; each person has their own name + PIN
